subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on December 10th, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AC123 Departure: New York (JFK) at 10:00 AM Arrival: London (Heathrow) at 10:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, Flight Booking Team
